Subject: MAP checkpoint: ACME evaluation commitments & next steps

Hi Sarah —

Thanks again for the sync this morning. Per our mutual action plan I wanted to capture the short list of commitments and owners so we’re aligned on deliverables before next week’s demo. I’ve attached an updated MAP workbook (ACME_MAP_v2.xlsx) with explicit due dates. Key items below: 

- Redwood to provide dedicated perf baseline report for the three workloads (30k tokens/day) — owner: Karthik — due: 2027-05-20
- ACME to share redlined security questionnaire responses (SOC2 evidence pointers) — owner: Sarah / Procurement — due: 2027-05-19
- Redwood to prepare SOW draft reflecting the pilot capacity and SLA targets — owner: Priya — due: 2027-05-21
- Confirm production date window & decision gate criteria — owners: Jordan (Redwood) + Sarah (ACME) — decision by 2027-05-27

Next-week agenda items (30m): quick perf review, security Q&A, final SOW walk-through, sign-off checklist.

Please confirm owners/dates or reply with changes and I’ll update the MAP workbook. I’ve also added a link to the HubSpot deal for tracking: https://app.hubspot.com/deal/84321

Thanks —
Jordan Blake
Senior Sales Manager, Redwood Inference
jordan.blake@redwood.ai | +1 415-555-0199

Attachment: ACME_MAP_v2.xlsx (spreadsheet, 3 sheets: milestones, owners, evidence)
Attachment: SOW-draft-v1.pdf (PDF, redline expected)

From: Sarah Lee <sarah.lee@acme.com>

Cc: Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwood.ai>, Procurement <procurement@acme.com>
Date: 2027-05-17T10:04:00-07:00
Subject: Re: MAP checkpoint: ACME evaluation commitments & next steps

Jordan —

Appreciate the clear breakdown. Quick confirmations: 

- ACME will aim to deliver the redlined security questionnaire by 2027-05-19 EOD. Procurement will include references to our internal SOC2 binder.
- We’d like the perf baseline to include 95th percentile latency in addition to avg throughput — can Karthik include that?
- SOW: procurement will review SOW-draft-v1 and send initial comments; we may ask for a clause that clarifies data residency during the pilot.

Two asks from our side before the demo: 
1) a short one-page summary slide of expected failure modes and fallback behavior for the pilot (for our ops lead),
2) confirmation that the dedicated pilot nodes will be isolated to the EU cluster if we request (we are still evaluating region constraints).

We’ll keep Procurement looped.

—Sarah
Sarah Lee
Head of Platform, ACME Corp
sarah.lee@acme.com

- Owner: Karthik Iyer (analysis & runbook). Support: Evelyn for infra validation.
